events.title: iPhone 17 released
events.summary: Apple began selling the iPhone 17, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17 Pro line on September 19, 2025 — 120Hz ProMotion on the base model, iOS 26, and doubled base storage.
events.about: The iPhone 17 dropped the Plus size for an ultra-thin iPhone Air and brought ProMotion to the standard tier. iOS 26's Liquid Glass design and Apple Intelligence updates gave developers new system APIs — continuing the annual hardware cadence that sets the mobile baseline after iPhone 16.

narrative.whyChosen: The iPhone 17 made high-refresh displays and 256GB base storage the new mainstream iOS floor.
narrative.whyImportant: iOS 26 and the Air form factor reshaped what apps can assume about screen size and AI integration.
narrative.problemSolved: Base iPhones lagged Pro displays and storage while Apple pushed on-device AI features.

events.title: OpenAI Sora 2 released
events.summary: OpenAI released Sora 2 on September 30, 2025 — a flagship video and audio generation model with a social iOS app and synced-audio clips.
events.about: Sora 2 added realistic physics, character cameos, and remix features in a TikTok-style feed — OpenAI's push to make generative video a consumer product, not just a research demo. It arrived months after Google's Veo competition and set up the Sora app's short-lived run before shutdown in 2026.

narrative.whyChosen: Sora 2 turned OpenAI's video research into a consumer social product.
narrative.whyImportant: Synced audio and character features made AI video shareable at phone scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Text-to-video tools lacked social discovery and consistent physics for mainstream use.
